rows.userPromise: Check discovers a new stable version without false positives and clearly reports up to date.
rows.observableResult: A newer stable version is offered; equal or older remote version shows up to date; draft/prerelease/unknown channel never offered.
uncovered: Live GitHub response and real TLS/redirect chain

rows.userPromise: The update chooser selects an ABI-compatible APK for this device.
rows.observableResult: arm64 device prefers arm64 and may fall back to universal; unsupported/mismatched native payload is rejected before installer handoff.
uncovered: Real APK native inventory on production artifacts

rows.userPromise: Downloads expose progress, cancellation, resume or a clear restart path without misreporting completion.
rows.observableResult: In-progress and cancelled states are visible; interrupted transfers resume only with stable source validators or restart from zero; byte completion is labeled unverified.
uncovered: Process death, device reboot, DNS loss and storage-full runtime injection

rows.userPromise: Corrupt, truncated, wrong-source, wrong-package, downgrade or wrong-signer APKs are rejected.
rows.observableResult: Only a unique trusted asset with matching size, SHA-256, package, versionCode, versionName, minSdk and signer set reaches VERIFIED.

rows.userPromise: Download success is never shown as installation success.
rows.observableResult: UI says download complete, waiting for verification; it never says installed or opens installer automatically.

rows.userPromise: The verified package is handed only to the Android system installer after explicit confirmation.
rows.observableResult: Exactly one trusted system installer receives the correctly scoped FileProvider URI; missing, ambiguous or permission-denied handlers fail visibly.

rows.userPromise: Installed success is shown only after external confirmation; otherwise the result is explicit UNKNOWN.
rows.entry: System installer return or app restart
rows.observableResult: Exact packageName, longVersionCode, versionName and signer set produce INSTALL_CONFIRMED; launch alone, generic version increase or missing readback produce INSTALL_UNKNOWN.
uncovered: Actual report-return behavior across OEM installers

rows.userPromise: Cancel and installer absence/permission denial have clear, non-success outcomes.
rows.action: Cancel download/install or encounter unavailable installer
rows.observableResult: Cancel maps to CANCELLED only with explicit evidence; installer absence/permission denial maps to a user-visible FAILED reason.

rows.userPromise: Restart after an interrupted verifier/installer flow does not create a false success.
rows.entry: App relaunch after download or installer handoff
rows.action: Resume or reconcile persisted update state
rows.observableResult: Unverified files are rehashed; stale authorization is dropped; post-handoff process restart without exact readback becomes INSTALL_UNKNOWN.
uncovered: Actual process-death and full-device reboot execution

rows.userPromise: An update failure does not damage or uninstall the existing app, and Jellyfin server updates are not used.
rows.action: Reject candidate or exit installer flow
rows.observableResult: Pre-handoff failures leave the installed app intact; no Jellyfin update-write endpoint is called; retry/re-download entry remains visible.
uncovered: Installed app data integrity after successful Android update
